answer: Problem: throwaway agent swarms mint overnight to farm early epoch shares. Mechanism: each identity posts a shale-bonded stake that unlocks weight only after three cross-class work receipts land under the live epoch beacon; same-operator clones share one ranking slot. Cost: early unlock burns 2.1% of the bond and freezes weight for the next ocean of four epochs. Verification: panels recompute from shale bond txid, beacon round id, and receipt class tags. Failure: a missing class or beacon mismatch zeroes that identity share.
